newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran civilian helicopter crash kills pilot.
newsitem.headline: Iran civilian helicopter crash kills pilot.

text.p: A civilian Iranian helicopter crashed outside Tehran on Monday, killing the pilot, Iran's official news agency IRNA said.

It said the helicopter belonged to the National Iranian Oil Company and was on a routine flight when it crashed about 50 km (30 miles) southwest of the capital, killing the pilot who was the only person on board.

Early reports said technical failure caused the crash of the chopper which was flying from Karaj, 40 km (25 miles) west of Tehran, to Isfahan, some 360 km (225 miles) to the south, the agency said. It did not give further details.
